context: Hina and Sho reflect on growing up.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright, clear announcement with wonder in her voice. Quick opening attack. Slightly breathless on the realization—like she's just noticing it herself. Warm, genuine child-voice throughout. Soft trailing wonder at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quiet, genuine appreciation. Very small voice. Soft attack, no performance. Warm and sincere underneath. Lets the words land gently, not rushing.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: ずっと、一緒、本当に、嬉しい。
lines.en: I'm so glad we've been together all this time.
lines.style: Clear, earnest delivery with real feeling. Opening reaches slightly—this matters. Child-bright tone but grounded in sincerity. Slow, deliberate pace. Trails off gently, like a quiet promise.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I'll take care of our friendship.
lines.style: Very small, steady voice. Serious in the way only a six-year-old can be. Soft, committed tone. No rush. Each word given equal weight. Genuine warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Hopeful lift on the opening. Child-bright and certain. Quick, easy pace. The question reaches upward slightly—looking for confirmation. Closes with warmth and a soft, satisfied trailing-off.
